sentences.en: The successful concert tour established her reputation as a singer.
sentences.zh: 这次成功的巡回演唱会确立了她歌手的身份。

sentences.en: The police could not establish the identity of the man.
sentences.zh: 警方无法确认那男人的身份。

sentences.en: The police established where he was when the crime occurred.
sentences.zh: 警方查明了犯罪发生时他所在的位置。
